versions.changelog:
Initial release with support for validated, high-demand self-improving workflow assistance.

- Provides structured support for users needing self-improving and proactive agent-style workflows.
- Outputs include work plans, templates, checklists, implementation support, and validation notes.
- Designed to help fix bugs, improve reliability, and create adjacent skills based on proven patterns.
- Local-hardware-friendly: prefers scripts and templates over cloud or large-model approaches.
- Responds to a wide set of workflow/productivity trigger keywords and phrases.
